About

I make complicated work easier to run.

My experience spans operations, product delivery, programme management, and creative production. Across these environments, my work has centred on coordinating people, creating clear processes, tracking priorities, and making sure the details do not get lost between planning and delivery.

I enjoy building the structure teams need to do their best work: practical SOPs, useful trackers, clear ownership, and communication that keeps everyone moving in the same direction.

05

How I approach the work

Operations dashboard

Challenge
When several workstreams move at once, updates can become scattered across messages and individual trackers, making ownership, dependencies, and risks harder to see.

Approach
I use a single view for workstream status, next milestones, action owners, due dates, and escalation rules.

Why this structure
It helps a lead answer four questions quickly: What is moving? What is at risk? Who owns the next action? What needs a decision?

Product delivery tracker

Challenge
Cross-functional work is difficult to track when features depend on multiple teams and completion criteria are unclear.

Approach
I structure tracking around priority, status, dependencies, and acceptance evidence, paired with a decision and risk log.

Why this structure
It connects status to what must be true before an item is considered complete, supporting clearer handoffs and delivery reviews.
